[Read Article][59]

## The Power to Make It Real™

At Wolfspeed, we are the creators of the next-generation semiconductor technology that powers the
world’s most disruptive innovations. In other words, it’s our job to make humankind’s greatest
ambitions – real.

For us, making it real means making it the Wolfspeed way. We deliver unparalleled reliability on a
massive scale from the first U.S.-based silicon carbide corridor with end-to-end substrate and power
device fabrication to fulfill the world’s growing demand.

## Our technology commitment

[
[Close-up photo of a red tractor in a snow-covered field. Used to symbolize how Wolfspeed's
portfolio is strong and durable.]

### Designed to last, even in the harshest environments

We enable our customers to design longer-lasting systems to perform in tough operating environments
with products delivering ruggedness at every stage of product life cycle.

Learn more
][80]
[Three large solar panels set against a green field mid-ground and mountainous background. Image
used as an example of our energy storage technology.]

### Designed to comprehensively improve system efficiency

We empower our customers to more effectively create, convert and store energy with technology
providing higher ampacity while minimizing conduction and switching losses.

[Close up image of an electric car that is plugged in and charging. Used to illustrate how our
product line enables you to use high quality products without adding to product time.]

### Designed to reduce system cost and development time

We equip our customers to pivot to new system architectures to minimize their maintenance costs and
production time with clean switching and high-performance devices.

## The Pioneers of Silicon Carbide

[

### About Wolfspeed

Wolfspeed continues to lead the industry transition from silicon to silicon carbide across both
materials and devices as the world’s only pure-play, vertically integrated silicon carbide company.
As the pioneers of silicon carbide, we are committed to powering a better world for everyone.

Who We Are

### Interchangeable USB Receptacle

Enerlites USB outlets make charging easier, faster, and more efficient by combining AC power and
built-in USB ports in one device. They free up outlet space, reduce clutter from charging blocks,
and provide reliable high-speed charging for phones, tablets, and other electronics. Ideal for
homes, offices, hotels, and shared spaces, Enerlites USB solutions offer a cleaner, more convenient
way to keep devices powered throughout the day.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

register now.

The challenges of tomorrow demand an upgrade today. We power your ideas with artificial
intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world
impact.

# Time to Take Control

Home and Office
Home and Office Automation

Automate lighting, temperature control, appliances, fountains, sprinklers and more, so you can focus
on what really matters.

Time and Money
Save Time, Money, and Hassle

TORK Mechanical and Digital timers, paired with our array of sensor and alert products, automate the
operation of any home or business.

Legacy
More than 100 Years of Legacy

We build TORK products with the same values of innovation, reliability, quality, and precision that
have guided us since 1922.

[previous arrow]
[next arrow]

### Timers

**The simple control way to automate your home or office with multiple modes and professional-grade
accuracy.**

[Digital Time Switch][169]

### Occupancy Sensors

**Reliable, instantaneous, automated responses to control anything from outdoor lighting to facility
safety.**

[Electronic][173]

### Photocontrols

**Use light-sensing technology to automate daily routines, saving time, energy and trouble.**

**Same time, money and hassle with these easy-to-use Wi-Fi integrated solutions. **

[See Products][178]

## TORK Innovations

#### **TORK Turtle Weatherproof Timers**

Our new in-use weatherproof outlet cover features a design inspired by nature and designed to beat
nature.
* Extra-duty strength
* Horizontal or vertical installation
* Indoor or outdoor use
* UL-listed for performance
* Customizable knockouts and plates

[Explore the TORK Turtle][179]

#### **Wi-Fi Automation Solutions**

Control your home or business directly from your phone using TORK’s suite of Wi-Fi-integrated
outlets and timers.
* Save time, money and hassle
* Residential or commercial
* Built to TORK’s high standards
* Easy digital integration
* Simplify your customers’ lives

[Explore Wi-Fi Products][180]

## A Century of Excellence

TORK, a pioneer in the electrical industry since 1922, offers switches, controls and timers that
give you simple ways to automate your home or office. TORK products include digital and mechanical
options alongside a wide range of sensors, switches, indicators and other controls.

## RELIABILITY

TORK timers are our specialty, with mechanical and digital options available for any residential or
commercial installation.

[Wifi Timer US Engineering TORK Automation Solutions]

## US-Engineered

Our US-based engineering and testing operations support American industry while maintaining our high
standard of quality.

## Legacy

The TORK name represents over 100 years of excellence in the electrical industry, combined with
innovative new modern deisgns.

# Big Timer

Big Timer is a fullscreen countdown timer for workshops, presentations and meetings in your browser

Please go to [bigtimer.net][1] in a browser with javascript enabled to use Big Timer.

## Do you have Javascript enabled?

Press CMD+Shift+R on a Mac or CTRL+Shift+R on Windows to force-reload the page. If that doesn't
help, please clear your browser history for bigtimer.net.:

### Chrome
1. Press CMD+Y on a Mac or CTRL-H on Windows
2. Search bigtimer in your history
3. Select all instances of Big Timer in the search results
4. Press the three dots on the right
5. Remove the website from Chrome's history

### Firefox
1. Press CTRL-H on Windows or, on a Mac, go to History > Show all history
2. Search bigtimer in your history
3. Select all instances of Big Timer in the search results
4. Right-click
5. Click Remove pages

### Safari on MacOS
1. Press CMD+Y
2. Search bigtimer in your history
3. Select all instances of Big Timer in the search results
4. Click Edit
5. Click Delete

### Safari on iOS
1. Go to your homescreen
2. Tap Settings
3. Scroll down and tap Safari
4. Tap Advanced at the bottom
5. Tap Website Data
6. Find bigtimer.net
7. Swipe left on bigtimer.net, press delete

If you don't see Big Timer in your history, javascript may be disabled in your browser after all.

[1]: https://www.bigtimer.net

We’re putting style, design and value at the center of everything we do. And four clear priorities
are guiding strategic choices aimed at delighting guests and driving profitable growth in 2026 and
beyond.

Since 1962, Target has been a leader in style and design, bringing our only-at-Target assortment and
guest experience to more than 2,000 communities coast to coast.

## [
## ][41]
## Using Notion API

Notion connections let you connect your workspace to external tools and automate workflows through
code. With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages,
databases, users, comments, and more. When you create a connection, you define what it can do: which
API endpoints it can call, what content it can read or write, and how it authenticates. Each
connection gets its own credentials and its own set of permissions.

## [
## ][42]
## What is a Notion connection?

A Notion [connection][43] — sometimes called an integration — connects your workspace to external
apps and tools. That could be a SaaS product, an automation script, or a custom tool you’ve built.
Connections are added to Notion workspaces and require **explicit permission** from users to access
Notion pages and databases.

Create Notion connections that unlock new possibilities for teams.

Notion already has a [library][44] of connections you can browse. For developers who want to build
their own, Notion supports internal connections, public connections, and personal access tokens —
all powered by the same REST API.

## [
## ][45]
## Connection types

Notion supports three authentication models:
* **Internal connections** are scoped to a single workspace and use a static API token. They’re
  ideal for custom automations and workflows — things like syncing data, sending notifications, or
  building internal dashboards.
* **Public connections** use OAuth 2.0 for authentication. At creation time, you choose their
  [installation scope][46]: **Any workspace** (any Notion user can install; Marketplace-eligible) or
  **Selected workspaces only** (restricted to workspaces you select; not Marketplace-eligible).
* **Personal access tokens (PATs)** are user-scoped tokens for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, and
  tools that should act as one Notion user. A PAT uses the creator’s workspace membership and page
  permissions. See [Personal access tokens][47].
Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being [listed on the
Marketplace][48]. You can create and use a public connection without listing it.

## [
## ][50]
## Shared concepts

All connection and token types share a few core concepts.

### [
### ][51]
### Capabilities

Every connection or token has a set of capabilities that control what it can do — read content,
update content, insert content, read comments, and more. You configure capabilities when you create
a connection or PAT. See the [Capabilities reference][52] for the full list.

## Pages

Create, update, and retrieve page content.

## Databases

Manage database, properties, entries, and schemas.

## Views

Create and configure database views programmatically.

## Data sources

Manage data sources, properties, entries, and schemas.

## File uploads

Upload and attach files to pages and databases.

## Comments

Handle page and inline comments.

## Content queries

Search through workspace content.

## Users

Access user profiles and permissions.

### [
### ][53]
### Content access

Connections must have access to pages and databases before they can interact with them. The
mechanism differs by type:
* **Internal connections** can be granted access in two ways: the connection owner can add pages
  directly from the **Content access** tab in the Developer portal, or workspace members can share
  pages via the **Add connections** menu in Notion.
* **Public connections** use the OAuth page picker, where users select which pages to grant access
  to during the authorization flow.
* **Personal access tokens** use the token creator’s existing Notion permissions. If the creator can
  access a page in Notion, a PAT with the right capabilities can access it through the API.
See the [Internal connections][54], [Public connections][55], and [Personal access tokens][56]
guides for specifics on how content access works for each type.

### [
### ][57]
### Webhooks

Connections can subscribe to real-time events — like page updates, property changes, and new
comments — via webhooks. This allows your connection to react to changes in Notion without polling
the API. See the [Webhooks guide][58] for details on setting up webhook subscriptions.

## [
## ][59]
## Getting started

The fastest way to start building is the [**Quickstart**][60] — create a personal access token, make
your first API request, and see a new page appear in your workspace in under two minutes. Once
you’re ready to build further, choose the authentication model that fits your use case:
1
[**Personal access tokens**][61] — Authenticate as yourself for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, or
trusted tools.
2
[**Internal connections**][62] — Build team-owned automations with a dedicated bot identity scoped
to one workspace.

## Using Notion API

Notion connections let you connect your workspace to external tools and automate workflows through
code. With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages,
databases, users, comments, and more. When you create a connection, you define what it can do: which

## [
## ][42]
## What is a Notion connection?

A Notion [connection][43] — sometimes called an integration — connects your workspace to external
apps and tools. That could be a SaaS product, an automation script, or a custom tool you’ve built.

Create Notion connections that unlock new possibilities for teams.

## ][45]

## [
## ][50]
## Shared concepts

All connection and token types share a few core concepts.

### [
### ][51]
### Capabilities

Every connection or token has a set of capabilities that control what it can do — read content,
update content, insert content, read comments, and more. You configure capabilities when you create
a connection or PAT. See the [Capabilities reference][52] for the full list.

## Pages

Create, update, and retrieve page content.

## Databases

Manage database, properties, entries, and schemas.

## Views

Create and configure database views programmatically.

## Data sources

Manage data sources, properties, entries, and schemas.

## File uploads

Upload and attach files to pages and databases.

## Comments

Handle page and inline comments.

## Content queries

Search through workspace content.

## Users

Access user profiles and permissions.

### [
### ][53]
### Content access

Connections must have access to pages and databases before they can interact with them. The
mechanism differs by type:
* **Internal connections** can be granted access in two ways: the connection owner can add pages
  directly from the **Content access** tab in the Developer portal, or workspace members can share
  pages via the **Add connections** menu in Notion.
* **Public connections** use the OAuth page picker, where users select which pages to grant access
  to during the authorization flow.
* **Personal access tokens** use the token creator’s existing Notion permissions. If the creator can
  access a page in Notion, a PAT with the right capabilities can access it through the API.
See the [Internal connections][54], [Public connections][55], and [Personal access tokens][56]
guides for specifics on how content access works for each type.

### [
### ][57]
### Webhooks

Connections can subscribe to real-time events — like page updates, property changes, and new
comments — via webhooks. This allows your connection to react to changes in Notion without polling
the API. See the [Webhooks guide][58] for details on setting up webhook subscriptions.

## [
## ][59]
## Getting started

The fastest way to start building is the [**Quickstart**][60] — create a personal access token, make
your first API request, and see a new page appear in your workspace in under two minutes. Once
you’re ready to build further, choose the authentication model that fits your use case:
1
[**Personal access tokens**][61] — Authenticate as yourself for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, or
trusted tools.
2
[**Internal connections**][62] — Build team-owned automations with a dedicated bot identity scoped
to one workspace.
3
[**Public connections**][63] — Build apps for other Notion users with OAuth 2.0.
4
[**Authorization**][64] — Implement the OAuth 2.0 flow for public connections.
5
[**Handling API keys**][65] — Secure and manage your API tokens in production.
6
[**Preparing for users**][66] — Set up databases, pages, and views automatically when users install
your connection.
7
[**List on the Marketplace**][67] — Make your public connection discoverable to all Notion users.

## IoT Solutions for Every Industrial Application

### Telematics & Fleet Management

**Know where your vehicles are and what they’re doing.**

Fleet operators need more than a dot on a map. EasyNet Technologies supplies GPS trackers, OBD
devices, and video telematics hardware that connect to your fleet management software — covering
vehicles, trailers, and assets. Geofencing, driver behaviour, cold chain monitoring, route
optimisation — the hardware is here.

### Agriculture

**Remote visibility across fields, livestock, and supply chains.**

Modern farming operations rely on data that is difficult to collect manually. EasyNet Technologies
supplies LoRaWAN sensors and IoT gateways that connect to precision agriculture platforms —
monitoring soil conditions, microclimate, and asset location across large areas. Low power, long
range, minimal infrastructure required.

### Retail

**Connected hardware for the modern shop floor.**

Retail operations depend on accurate, up-to-date information. Electronic shelf labels reduce manual
pricing work. RFID readers give stock teams real-time inventory visibility. EasyNet Technologies
supplies the hardware that makes retail automation practical — from a single store to a national
rollout.

### Smart City

**Connectivity infrastructure built for outdoor, long-term deployment.**

Smart city projects span hundreds of locations and run for years. EasyNet Technologies supplies
industrial routers and LoRaWAN gateways designed for that environment — supporting smart lighting,
environmental monitoring, traffic management, and public safety networks across distributed urban
infrastructure.

### Industrial IoT (IIoT)

**Real-time data from the machines that matter.**

Unplanned downtime is expensive. EasyNet Technologies provides vibration sensors, condition
monitoring devices, and industrial IoT gateways that feed live data to your platform — giving
maintenance teams what they need to act before equipment fails. Suited for manufacturing, energy,
and heavy industry environments.

### Energy

**Granular energy data across every site and circuit.**

Reducing consumption starts with knowing where energy actually goes. EasyNet Technologie’s metering
hardware — data loggers, AMR devices, sub-metres — gives energy managers visibility by floor,
machine, or circuit. A practical starting point for ISO 50001 compliance or any structured energy
reduction programme.

### Healthcare

**Connected care, from hospital wards to home.**

Healthcare teams need to locate equipment quickly and monitor patients reliably. EasyNet
Technologies provides RFID and BLE hardware for asset tracking across hospital environments,
alongside devices supporting remote patient monitoring and telecare services. Less time searching
for equipment means more time with patients.

### Smart Buildings

**IoT hardware that gives facility teams real control.**

Buildings perform better when managers have accurate data. Occupancy sensors, smart lighting
controls, and BEMS-connected devices from EasyNet Technologies provide the visibility needed to
reduce energy waste and respond to how a building is actually used. Suitable for new builds and
retrofits alike.

## IoT Solutions for Every Industrial Application

### Telematics & Fleet Management

**Know where your vehicles are and what they’re doing.**

Fleet operators need more than a dot on a map. EasyNet Technologies supplies GPS trackers, OBD
devices, and video telematics hardware that connect to your fleet management software — covering
vehicles, trailers, and assets. Geofencing, driver behaviour, cold chain monitoring, route
optimisation — the hardware is here.

### Agriculture

**Remote visibility across fields, livestock, and supply chains.**

Modern farming operations rely on data that is difficult to collect manually. EasyNet Technologies
supplies LoRaWAN sensors and IoT gateways that connect to precision agriculture platforms —
monitoring soil conditions, microclimate, and asset location across large areas. Low power, long
range, minimal infrastructure required.

### Retail

**Connected hardware for the modern shop floor.**

Retail operations depend on accurate, up-to-date information. Electronic shelf labels reduce manual
pricing work. RFID readers give stock teams real-time inventory visibility. EasyNet Technologies
supplies the hardware that makes retail automation practical — from a single store to a national
rollout.

### Smart City

**Connectivity infrastructure built for outdoor, long-term deployment.**

Smart city projects span hundreds of locations and run for years. EasyNet Technologies supplies
industrial routers and LoRaWAN gateways designed for that environment — supporting smart lighting,
environmental monitoring, traffic management, and public safety networks across distributed urban
infrastructure.

### Industrial IoT (IIoT)

**Real-time data from the machines that matter.**

Unplanned downtime is expensive. EasyNet Technologies provides vibration sensors, condition
monitoring devices, and industrial IoT gateways that feed live data to your platform — giving
maintenance teams what they need to act before equipment fails. Suited for manufacturing, energy,
and heavy industry environments.

### Energy

**Granular energy data across every site and circuit.**

Reducing consumption starts with knowing where energy actually goes. EasyNet Technologie’s metering
hardware — data loggers, AMR devices, sub-metres — gives energy managers visibility by floor,
machine, or circuit. A practical starting point for ISO 50001 compliance or any structured energy
reduction programme.

### Healthcare

**Connected care, from hospital wards to home.**

Healthcare teams need to locate equipment quickly and monitor patients reliably. EasyNet
Technologies provides RFID and BLE hardware for asset tracking across hospital environments,
alongside devices supporting remote patient monitoring and telecare services. Less time searching
for equipment means more time with patients.

### Smart Buildings

**IoT hardware that gives facility teams real control.**

Buildings perform better when managers have accurate data. Occupancy sensors, smart lighting
controls, and BEMS-connected devices from EasyNet Technologies provide the visibility needed to
reduce energy waste and respond to how a building is actually used. Suitable for new builds and
retrofits alike.

Shortage Supply

Putting customers first

We manufacture each suspension individually to order - exactly matching the vehicle and the wishes
of our customers. Stock production and mass production are not part of our philosophy.

Manufacture on a grand scale

Each Coilover suspension and each [KW HAS][8] is assembled by hand at headquarters - customised and
with a preset damper setup for each vehicle model.

Motorsport in the blood

We are at home in motorsport: KW suspensions stand for top performance. We have been successful in
the toughest racing series in the world for decades.

We move with the times

Every order starts the fully automated process at our headquarters: 600 components, 67 work steps
and 120 minutes until a unique Coilover suspension is created.

[Homepage > SF 4 > Partners > Image Text]

## We go one step further for our customers

Fulfilling our customers' requirements is not enough for us - inspiring them with exceptional
driving experiences is our ultimate goal.

Information about your vehicle

## Find out about suitable products for your car

Select manufacturerSelect model
Here you can find information about vehicles. You can find all products for your vehicle [
in the shop.
][9]
[Homepage > SF 6 > Motorsport > Image-Text]
Motorsport

## Our best technology for the highest demands

In motorsport, we lead the way in renowned racing series worldwide, driven by our passion for
developing suspension solutions for demanding racetrack conditions. Tested at our German
headquarters, KW is the choice of many racing teams confident in their pursuit of victory.

[
To the motorsport area
][10]
Inspired by Racing

## The most innovative technologies for the best suspension systems

[
More pioneering KW technologies
][11]
FAQ

### Where is KW suspensions headquartered?

KW suspensions has its headquarters in Fichtenberg (Baden-Württemberg, Germany), together with other
well-known coilover suspension manufacturers such as [ST suspensions][12] and [ap
Sportfahrwerke][13] as well as the wheel manufacturer [BBS][14]. KW suspensions and all the other
manufacturers mentioned are subordinate to [KW automotive][15], which employs over 400 people in
Fichtenberg.

### Where can I buy KW suspensions?

On this website, you will find all the important information about our products. You can find out
about the special features of our Coilover suspensions or read about why an upgrade with KW
suspensions products is worthwhile for your specific vehicle model in our [KW suspensions vehicle
world][16]. Once you have decided which product is right for you, you can easily purchase it via our
[KW suspensions online shop][17].

### Can I also buy shock absorbers from KW suspensions?

No. At the moment, the sale of classic shock absorbers as spare parts is not yet possible at KW
suspensions. We will of course inform you when we have shock absorbers in our programme!

### What is a KW suspension?

A KW suspension is a vehicle upgrade to increase the driving dynamics of the coilover suspension
manufacturer KW suspensions. [The company][18] has been building its own Coilover suspensions since
the 1990s and has been successful worldwide ever since. Our proven KW technology is not only used by
customers with road vehicles, but also in renowned racing series all over the world. They rely on
our products and continue to achieve success year after year.

# Most of your market isn't worth calling today. We show you the part that is.

MarketSizer tracks real buying signals - active trials, renewals, competitor switches - so your team
works the accounts shopping around right now, not a list of thousands.

[Start for free][48][Book a demo][49]
[MarketSizer dashboard showing opportunity scores and pipeline]
Do I need a credit card?
No. 500 free credits, no time limit. Most teams know within 2 to 3 weeks whether MarketSizer is
delivering value.
Who is MarketSizer for?
B2B software vendors whose buyers evaluate competitors before they buy. Built first for CX and live
chat teams, expanding across CRM, ITSM, and sales enablement.
How accurate is your data?
Around 90% detection accuracy on active trials. Signals refresh daily with a 5-day max lag, and
every score is inspectable back to the signals that drove it.
Works inside the tools you already use
[HubSpot][Salesforce][Pipedrive][Apollo][Clay][Chrome]

## GTM teams waste time on the wrong accounts.

Most sales and marketing effort is wasted on accounts that were never going to move. Before they
engage, teams can't answer three questions: Is this account a good fit? Are they in-market and
actively evaluating right now? Can we actually win this deal? MarketSizer is the opportunity
intelligence layer that answers all three - reading observable buying signals like active trials,
renewals, and competitor switches to prioritise the accounts worth your team's time, before the
first outreach.

How it works

## From market signal
## to won deal

Three layers of intelligence, built on 70M+ real subscription outcomes - not anonymous web visits.

01 - Discover

### See who's actively evaluating

We track real evaluation activity - active trials, competitive churn, renewal windows - not
anonymous web visits.

Active trialsChurn signalsRenewal cycles

### Rank by fit, intent, and win likelihood

Opportunity Score combines ICP match, purchase intent, and scenario-specific win probability -
backed by 70M+ historical subscription outcomes.

ICP Match 40%Intent 35%Win Prob. 25%
03 - Act

### Reach them before the window closes

Push the account and its signal context into the CRM or sequencing tool your team already uses, so
the first touch lands while the window is still open.

ICP scoring, purchase intent, win likelihood, and ACV estimates in one ranked feed. Every account
pre-qualified before a rep sees it.
* Opportunity Score ranking across every account
* Estimated current and potential ACV
* Filter by vendor, signal type, geography

[Opportunity Discovery dashboard]
Intelligence

Real-time detection of active software evaluations and competitive signals. Know which vendor is
being trialled, how far in, and when the window closes.
* 2.5M+ active evaluations monitored
* Timing windows with expected decision dates
* Signal validation and confidence scoring

* 70M+ outcomes powering the model
* Vendor x segment x signal granularity
* 5-year switching propensity data

## Pay for what you can win.

one - and half of that waits until it converts.

“Most intent tools tell you who's researching. MarketSizer tells you who's actively trialling a
competitor - and when their contract window closes.”

Unlike generic intent signals, MarketSizer tracks real evaluation activity: vendor-specific trials,
competitive displacement moments, and renewal cycles. Backed by 70M+ historical subscription
outcomes, not anonymous page visits.

## Built for your role

MarketSizer adapts to how your team works - from frontline prospecting to strategic planning.

### SDRs & AEs

Walk into every call knowing exactly which vendor your prospect is trialling, how far into
evaluation they are, and when their decision window closes. No more cold prospecting into accounts
that already chose someone else last month.

[Learn more →][53]

### Marketing & Demand Gen

Run campaigns timed to active evaluation windows - not just firmographic fit. Reach accounts when
they're comparing options, not after they've already decided.

[Learn more →][54]

### Client Success & AMs

Know when a customer starts evaluating alternatives before they tell you. Catch churn risk at the
signal stage, not the notice stage - and spot expansion windows when adjacent teams go in-market.

[Learn more →][55]

### Revenue Operations

Replace gut-feel territory planning with market signal data. Score accounts across your entire
addressable market so forecast accuracy improves from day one - not quarter three.

[Learn more →][56]
FAQ

## Common questions

The fast answers. Full detail on the FAQ page.

What does MarketSizer do?

MarketSizer shows B2B software vendors which companies are actively in-market to buy their product,
qualified by ICP fit, purchase intent, and win probability. Instead of guessing who to target, your
team sees which companies are trialling your competitors right now, which recently churned from
incumbents and are evaluating alternatives, and which match the profile of customers you
historically win.

How is MarketSizer different from other intent tools?

Most intent tools show behavioural signals - website visits, content downloads, ad engagement.
MarketSizer shows subscription intelligence: which software companies actually use, when they trial
alternatives, and historical switching behaviour. Real, inspectable signals with timelines, full
competitive context, and a 5-day max detection lag - not anonymous page views and black-box scoring.

Who is MarketSizer for?

B2B software vendors whose buyers evaluate competitors before they buy. We are built first for
customer support and live chat vendors (companies like Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, LiveChat,
Crisp, and Gorgias) and expanding across ITSM, CRM, marketing automation, and sales enablement. The
platform is used by sales (AEs, SDRs/BDRs, leaders), marketing (demand gen, ABM, ops), and customer
success teams.

How accurate is your data?

MarketSizer tracks 50M+ companies and 70M+ historical subscription outcomes, with around 90%
detection accuracy on active trials and competitive switching moments. Signals refresh daily with a
maximum 5-day lag. Every score is inspectable - you can see exactly which signals drove a result and
when they were detected.

Do I need a credit card to start?

No. You get 500 free credits to start - no credit card required, no time limit. That is enough to
see which companies in your market are in-market right now, test the accuracy of our data against
your own knowledge, and validate that qualified opportunities convert better than your current
lists. Most teams know within 2 to 3 weeks whether MarketSizer is delivering value.

FAQ

## Common questions

The fast answers. Full detail on the FAQ page.

What does MarketSizer do?

MarketSizer shows B2B software vendors which companies are actively in-market to buy their product,
qualified by ICP fit, purchase intent, and win probability. Instead of guessing who to target, your
team sees which companies are trialling your competitors right now, which recently churned from
incumbents and are evaluating alternatives, and which match the profile of customers you
historically win.

How is MarketSizer different from other intent tools?

Most intent tools show behavioural signals - website visits, content downloads, ad engagement.
MarketSizer shows subscription intelligence: which software companies actually use, when they trial
alternatives, and historical switching behaviour. Real, inspectable signals with timelines, full
competitive context, and a 5-day max detection lag - not anonymous page views and black-box scoring.

Who is MarketSizer for?

B2B software vendors whose buyers evaluate competitors before they buy. We are built first for
customer support and live chat vendors (companies like Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, LiveChat,
Crisp, and Gorgias) and expanding across ITSM, CRM, marketing automation, and sales enablement. The
platform is used by sales (AEs, SDRs/BDRs, leaders), marketing (demand gen, ABM, ops), and customer
success teams.

How accurate is your data?

MarketSizer tracks 50M+ companies and 70M+ historical subscription outcomes, with around 90%
detection accuracy on active trials and competitive switching moments. Signals refresh daily with a
maximum 5-day lag. Every score is inspectable - you can see exactly which signals drove a result and
when they were detected.

Do I need a credit card to start?

No. You get 500 free credits to start - no credit card required, no time limit. That is enough to
see which companies in your market are in-market right now, test the accuracy of our data against
your own knowledge, and validate that qualified opportunities convert better than your current
lists. Most teams know within 2 to 3 weeks whether MarketSizer is delivering value.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

Large Jumbo Displays of 4 inch & 8 inch are critically required for process factories where process
parameters need to be monitored from large distances Inputs available like Thermocouples, RTD, mA, V
to monitor process variables such as temperature, pressure, level, humidity, and flow. All Displays
have RS485 Modbus communication.

mission. Protection soft alarms for Voltage health is an added feature

## Online Alarm Kur Nedir?

Online Alarm Kur, zamanında uyanmanıza ve gün boyu yerine getireceğiniz görevler için hatırlatıcılar
ayarlamanıza yardımcı olmak için tasarlanmış bir online araçtır.

Aracı kullanmak oldukça basittir; alarm kurmak istediğiniz saati ve alarm sesini seçin, alarmınıza
isim verin ve kaydedin. Sonrasında tek yapmanız gereken alarmın çalışması için tarayıcı sekmesini
açık tutmak. Böylece alarm sizi ayarladığınız saatte sesli bir şekilde uyaracaktır.

Belirli bir saat yerine süreyi ayarlamak için sitede yer alan [online zamanlayıcı][12] aracını
kullanabilirsiniz.

## Online Alarm Nasıl Kurulur?

Aracın kullanımı son derece kolay ve tamamen ücretsizdir. Aşağıda yer alan basit adımları takip
etmeniz yeterli olacaktır:
1. Alarm kurmadan önce ekranın üst kısmında yer alan [dijital saat][13] aracılığıyla geçerli saati
   kontrol edin.
2. **Alarm saatini ayarla** kısmından alarm kurmak istediğiniz zamanı Saat ve Dakika cinsinden seçin
   veya önceden seçilmiş alarm saatlerinden dilediğinizi işaretleyin.
3. Listede yer alanlar arasında tercih ettiğiniz bir **Alarm sesi** seçin.
4. Dilerseniz, **Alarm başlığı** kısmından alarmınıza bir isim verin.
5. Son olarak alarm kurmak için **Alarm Kur** butonuna tıklayın. Kurduğunuz saat geldiğinde
   alarmınız otomatik olarak çalacaktır.

Birden fazla alarm kurmak için yeni sekme açabilir ve yukarıda yer alan adımları dilediğiniz kadar
tekrarlayabilirsiniz. Alarm kurduktan sonra, ekranda otomatik olarak bir [geri sayım][14]
belirecektir. Bu sayaç, alarmınıza ne kadar süre kaldığını ve tam alarm saatini (alarmın çalacağı
saati) gösterir. Geri sayım sırasında yapabilecekleriniz aşağıdaki gibidir:
* Geri sayımı tam ekran olarak görüntülemek için ekranın sağ üst köşesinde yer alan tam ekran
  simgesine tıklayabilirsiniz.
* Dikkatiniz dağılmadan ekranınızı açık tutmaya yarayacak tamamen karanlık bir ekran için ampul
  simgesine tıklayabilirsiniz.
* Alarmı çalmadan önce iptal etmek için "Durdur" butonuna tıklayabilirsiniz.

Geri sayım sıfıra ulaştığında ve alarm çaldığında ekranda iki seçenek belirecektir:
* Alarmı sonlandırmak için **Durdur** butonuna tıklayın.
* 10 dakika ertelemek için **Ertele** butonuna tıklayın.

### Alarm ayarları

Alarmınızı özelleştirmek için ekranın sağ üst köşesinde yer alan "Ayarlar" simgesine tıklayın.
Burada aşağıdaki işlemleri yapabilirsiniz:
* Alarm sesinin şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.
* Varsayılan erteleme süresini değiştirebilirsiniz.
* Tekrarlayan alarm sesini etkinleştirebilir veya devre dışı bırakabilirsiniz.
* Alarm saatini (alarmın ne zaman çalacağını) gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.
* İlerleme çubuğunu gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular

### Alarm sesi yüksek mi?

Evet, alarm sesi yüksek olabilir. En üst sağda yer alan ayarlar ikonuna tıklayarak alarm sesinin
şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.

### İnternet bağlantısına ihtiyacım var mı?

Sayfayı yüklemek ve alarm kurmak için internet bağlantısı gerekir. Ancak bir kez alarm kurulduktan
sonra internet bağlantısı kesilse bile saati geldiğinde alarm çalacaktır.

### Sekmeyi kapatırsam alarm çalışır mı?

Hayır, sekmeyi kapatırsanız alarm çalışmaz. Ancak, alarmın çalması için tarayıcı sekmesinin etkin
olması gerekmez, diğer sekmelerde istediğinizi yapabilirsiniz.

### Bilgisayar uyku modundayken alarm çalışır mı?

Hayır, bilgisayar uyku modundaysa alarm çalışmaz. Ancak, yalnızca ekranınız kapalıyken alarm
çalışmaya devam edecektir.

Sisteminizin ekran kapalıyken alarmı etkin tutup tutmadığından emin değilseniz, önceden test edin
veya güvenlik için ekranınızı açık tutun. Dizüstü bilgisayarınızın kapağını kapatırsanız da aracın
çalışmayacağını lütfen unutmayın.

## Türkiye'nin Uyku Alışkanlıkları

Kullanıcılarımıza yönelik iki ayrı anonim ankette Türkiye'nin uyku rutinini inceledik. İlkinde yatış
ve uyanış saatlerini, ikincisinde ise uyku sürelerini ve hangi şehirde yaşadıklarını sorduk. Her iki
ankete de binden fazla kişi katıldı.

ayarlamanıza yardımcı olmak için tasarlanmış bir online araçtır.

Aracı kullanmak oldukça basittir; alarm kurmak istediğiniz saati ve alarm sesini seçin, alarmınıza
isim verin ve kaydedin. Sonrasında tek yapmanız gereken alarmın çalışması için tarayıcı sekmesini
açık tutmak. Böylece alarm sizi ayarladığınız saatte sesli bir şekilde uyaracaktır.

Belirli bir saat yerine süreyi ayarlamak için sitede yer alan [online zamanlayıcı][12] aracını
kullanabilirsiniz.

## Online Alarm Nasıl Kurulur?

Aracın kullanımı son derece kolay ve tamamen ücretsizdir. Aşağıda yer alan basit adımları takip
etmeniz yeterli olacaktır:
1. Alarm kurmadan önce ekranın üst kısmında yer alan [dijital saat][13] aracılığıyla geçerli saati
   kontrol edin.
2. **Alarm saatini ayarla** kısmından alarm kurmak istediğiniz zamanı Saat ve Dakika cinsinden seçin
   veya önceden seçilmiş alarm saatlerinden dilediğinizi işaretleyin.
3. Listede yer alanlar arasında tercih ettiğiniz bir **Alarm sesi** seçin.
4. Dilerseniz, **Alarm başlığı** kısmından alarmınıza bir isim verin.
5. Son olarak alarm kurmak için **Alarm Kur** butonuna tıklayın. Kurduğunuz saat geldiğinde
   alarmınız otomatik olarak çalacaktır.

Birden fazla alarm kurmak için yeni sekme açabilir ve yukarıda yer alan adımları dilediğiniz kadar
tekrarlayabilirsiniz. Alarm kurduktan sonra, ekranda otomatik olarak bir [geri sayım][14]
belirecektir. Bu sayaç, alarmınıza ne kadar süre kaldığını ve tam alarm saatini (alarmın çalacağı
saati) gösterir. Geri sayım sırasında yapabilecekleriniz aşağıdaki gibidir:
* Geri sayımı tam ekran olarak görüntülemek için ekranın sağ üst köşesinde yer alan tam ekran
  simgesine tıklayabilirsiniz.
* Dikkatiniz dağılmadan ekranınızı açık tutmaya yarayacak tamamen karanlık bir ekran için ampul
  simgesine tıklayabilirsiniz.
* Alarmı çalmadan önce iptal etmek için "Durdur" butonuna tıklayabilirsiniz.

Geri sayım sıfıra ulaştığında ve alarm çaldığında ekranda iki seçenek belirecektir:
* Alarmı sonlandırmak için **Durdur** butonuna tıklayın.
* 10 dakika ertelemek için **Ertele** butonuna tıklayın.

### Alarm ayarları

Alarmınızı özelleştirmek için ekranın sağ üst köşesinde yer alan "Ayarlar" simgesine tıklayın.
Burada aşağıdaki işlemleri yapabilirsiniz:
* Alarm sesinin şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.
* Varsayılan erteleme süresini değiştirebilirsiniz.
* Tekrarlayan alarm sesini etkinleştirebilir veya devre dışı bırakabilirsiniz.
* Alarm saatini (alarmın ne zaman çalacağını) gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.
* İlerleme çubuğunu gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular

### Alarm sesi yüksek mi?

Evet, alarm sesi yüksek olabilir. En üst sağda yer alan ayarlar ikonuna tıklayarak alarm sesinin
şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.

### İnternet bağlantısına ihtiyacım var mı?

Sayfayı yüklemek ve alarm kurmak için internet bağlantısı gerekir. Ancak bir kez alarm kurulduktan
sonra internet bağlantısı kesilse bile saati geldiğinde alarm çalacaktır.

### Sekmeyi kapatırsam alarm çalışır mı?

Hayır, sekmeyi kapatırsanız alarm çalışmaz. Ancak, alarmın çalması için tarayıcı sekmesinin etkin
olması gerekmez, diğer sekmelerde istediğinizi yapabilirsiniz.

### Bilgisayar uyku modundayken alarm çalışır mı?

Hayır, bilgisayar uyku modundaysa alarm çalışmaz. Ancak, yalnızca ekranınız kapalıyken alarm
çalışmaya devam edecektir.

Sisteminizin ekran kapalıyken alarmı etkin tutup tutmadığından emin değilseniz, önceden test edin
veya güvenlik için ekranınızı açık tutun. Dizüstü bilgisayarınızın kapağını kapatırsanız da aracın
çalışmayacağını lütfen unutmayın.

## Türkiye'nin Uyku Alışkanlıkları

Kullanıcılarımıza yönelik iki ayrı anonim ankette Türkiye'nin uyku rutinini inceledik. İlkinde yatış
ve uyanış saatlerini, ikincisinde ise uyku sürelerini ve hangi şehirde yaşadıklarını sorduk. Her iki
ankete de binden fazla kişi katıldı.

### Türkiye'de insanlar saat kaçta yatıyor?

Türkiye genelinde en çok tercih edilen yatış saatinin 23:00-23:59 aralığı olduğu, hemen ardından da
00:00-00:59 ve 22:00-22:59 aralıklarının geldiği tespit edildi.

### Türkiye'de insanlar saat kaçta uyanıyor?

Katılımcıların uyanmak için en çok tercih ettikleri saat aralığı 07:00-07:59 olarak belirlendi.
Takip eden aralıklar ise 06:00-06:59 ve 08:00-08:59 oldu.

### Türkiye'de insanlar kaç saat uyuyor?

Katılımcıların geceleri en çok belirttiği uyku süresinin 7-8 saat aralığı olduğu görüldü. Takip eden
aralıklar ise 6-7 saat ve 5-6 saat oldu.

### Şehirlerin uyku alışkanlıkları

Türkiye'nin en az uyuyan ili 6 saat 14 dakikalık ortalamasıyla Mersin oldu. Onu Kocaeli (6 saat 16
dakika), İzmir (6 saat 32 dakika) ve İstanbul (6 saat 38 dakika) takip etti.

Listenin diğer tarafında ise 7 saat 25 dakikalık ortalamasıyla Konya, en çok uyuyan il olarak öne
çıktı. Onu Van (7 saat 8 dakika) ve Denizli (6 saat 57 dakika) izledi.

* Alarm sesinin şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.
* Varsayılan erteleme süresini değiştirebilirsiniz.
* Tekrarlayan alarm sesini etkinleştirebilir veya devre dışı bırakabilirsiniz.
* Alarm saatini (alarmın ne zaman çalacağını) gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.
* İlerleme çubuğunu gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular

### Alarm sesi yüksek mi?

Evet, alarm sesi yüksek olabilir. En üst sağda yer alan ayarlar ikonuna tıklayarak alarm sesinin
şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.

### İnternet bağlantısına ihtiyacım var mı?

Sayfayı yüklemek ve alarm kurmak için internet bağlantısı gerekir. Ancak bir kez alarm kurulduktan
sonra internet bağlantısı kesilse bile saati geldiğinde alarm çalacaktır.

### Sekmeyi kapatırsam alarm çalışır mı?

Hayır, sekmeyi kapatırsanız alarm çalışmaz. Ancak, alarmın çalması için tarayıcı sekmesinin etkin
olması gerekmez, diğer sekmelerde istediğinizi yapabilirsiniz.

### Bilgisayar uyku modundayken alarm çalışır mı?

Hayır, bilgisayar uyku modundaysa alarm çalışmaz. Ancak, yalnızca ekranınız kapalıyken alarm
çalışmaya devam edecektir.

Sisteminizin ekran kapalıyken alarmı etkin tutup tutmadığından emin değilseniz, önceden test edin
veya güvenlik için ekranınızı açık tutun. Dizüstü bilgisayarınızın kapağını kapatırsanız da aracın
çalışmayacağını lütfen unutmayın.

## Türkiye'nin Uyku Alışkanlıkları

Kullanıcılarımıza yönelik iki ayrı anonim ankette Türkiye'nin uyku rutinini inceledik. İlkinde yatış
ve uyanış saatlerini, ikincisinde ise uyku sürelerini ve hangi şehirde yaşadıklarını sorduk. Her iki
ankete de binden fazla kişi katıldı.

### Türkiye'de insanlar saat kaçta yatıyor?

Türkiye genelinde en çok tercih edilen yatış saatinin 23:00-23:59 aralığı olduğu, hemen ardından da
00:00-00:59 ve 22:00-22:59 aralıklarının geldiği tespit edildi.

### Türkiye'de insanlar saat kaçta uyanıyor?

Katılımcıların uyanmak için en çok tercih ettikleri saat aralığı 07:00-07:59 olarak belirlendi.
Takip eden aralıklar ise 06:00-06:59 ve 08:00-08:59 oldu.

### Türkiye'de insanlar kaç saat uyuyor?

Katılımcıların geceleri en çok belirttiği uyku süresinin 7-8 saat aralığı olduğu görüldü. Takip eden
aralıklar ise 6-7 saat ve 5-6 saat oldu.

### Şehirlerin uyku alışkanlıkları

Türkiye'nin en az uyuyan ili 6 saat 14 dakikalık ortalamasıyla Mersin oldu. Onu Kocaeli (6 saat 16
dakika), İzmir (6 saat 32 dakika) ve İstanbul (6 saat 38 dakika) takip etti.

Listenin diğer tarafında ise 7 saat 25 dakikalık ortalamasıyla Konya, en çok uyuyan il olarak öne
çıktı. Onu Van (7 saat 8 dakika) ve Denizli (6 saat 57 dakika) izledi.

# The Pomodoro® Technique

A complete productivity system — not just a timer. Created by Francesco Cirillo.

The timer is only the starting point. The full Pomodoro® Technique includes **daily planning,
interruption management, and effort estimation** — a complete system for making deep work
sustainable. Start with the free resources below, or learn the complete method in the official
self-paced program.

[View the Program][9] [Download Free Sheets][10]

## Official Self-Paced Program

20 weeks. Entirely online. From the creator of the technique.

#### Practitioner Program

$49 / 5 months access

Video lessons, exercises, worksheets, quizzes, Weekly Notes from Francesco, and Certificate of
Completion.

Founding price. Future: $149

#### Certified Practitioner

$149 / 5 months access

Everything in the Practitioner Program plus 3 evaluated assignments, written feedback from
Francesco, and official Certified Practitioner credential.

Founding price. Future: $499

[View the Program][11]

## Start Free

Everything you need for your first Pomodoro® session. Download the sheets, pick a timer, and begin.

#### Pomodoro® Quick-Start eGuide - FREE

**Your first Pomodoro® in 5 minutes**
Skip the theory, start now. One page with the absolute minimum to begin your first Pomodoro® session
immediately.

[ Download Sheet ][12]

#### Pomodoro® To-Do Today eSheet - FREE

**Plan your daily Pomodoros**
Select tasks from your Activity Inventory and commit to what you'll accomplish today. Track
completed Pomodoros and handle interruptions.

[ Download Sheet ][13]

#### Pomodoro® Activity Inventory eSheet - FREE

**Capture and organize all your tasks**
The foundation of the Pomodoro® Technique. List everything you need to do, estimate effort, and
prioritize effectively.

[ Download Sheet ][14]

#### Pomodoro® Records eSheet - FREE

**Track progress and improve your process**
Record completed Pomodoros to understand how long tasks really take. Essential for improving your
planning accuracy over time.

[ Download Sheet ][15]

#### Pomodoro® Timers — FREE

Three official timers, all free. Browser needs no installation. Desktop integrates with Windows. PWA
works on all devices including mobile.

[Web Timer][16] [Windows][17] [PWA][18]

#### The Pomodoro® Technique — Book, Ebook and Audiobook

**The original guide by Francesco Cirillo**
Learn the complete methodology from its creator. Understand not just what to do, but why each
element matters for sustainable productivity. Available in 15+ languages.

[Buy Now][19]

#### Focus Session with Francesco Cirillo

**2-hour live session**
Apply the technique to your real context. Set goals, review progress, or refine your practice. Book
separately when you want direct help.

[Learn More][20]

## For Companies & Teams

Equip your entire organization with official tools, training materials, and bulk timers. Corporate
and B2B orders only.

#### Pomodoro® Classic Timer

**The original mechanical kitchen timer**
Mechanical timer in classic tomato shape. The physical act of winding creates commitment. Perfect
for training sessions and workshops. Bulk orders only.

[Request B2B Quote][21]

#### Pomodoro® DigitalTimer

**Modern timer for office environments**
Professional digital timer for desk use. Large display ensures visibility across open offices. Bulk
orders only.

[Request B2B Quote][22]

#### Pomodoro® Starter Kit

**Official notebooks and pencils for your team**
Equip your corporate training sessions with the official Pomodoro® notebook and pencil, designed
specifically for the technique. Bulk orders only.

[Request B2B Quote][23]

## Start Your Pomodoro® Journey Today

Begin with the free resources, or learn the complete technique in the official self-paced program
created by Francesco Cirillo.

**Why Progressive?:** We guarantee repairs for as long as you own or lease your vehicle when you

#### Quote now & get covered for as low as $100/year^{**}

With Progressive, you can take your boat to any lake or river, plus ocean waters within 75 miles of
the coast. And we offer a variety of coverages to protect your boat and the good times that come
with it. Quote now to get started.

**Why Progressive?:** With on-water towing, fuel spill removal, mechanical breakdown coverage, and
more, you can float on without worry.

[Learn more about boat][34]

#### Get the coverage you need to keep your business growing

From general liability to cyber insurance, you can find the coverages you need to protect your
company from severe financial loss. Start a quote today and safeguard your business from the
unexpected.

[Learn more about business][35]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][36]

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][37]

#### Cover yourself for everything your condo association doesn't

Your home's structure may be protected, but what about everything inside? With condo insurance, you
can be covered for theft, damage, and more. Get a quote today for greater peace of mind.

**Why Progressive?:** We cover your belongings, temporary living expenses, home upgrades, and more
so you don’t have to worry about gaps in coverage.

[Learn more about condo][38]

#### Safeguard your most valuable asset

Protect your home, belongings, and financial security with homeowners insurance. With a variety of
coverages, and plenty of ways to save, you can create a policy that keeps your home safe and fits
your budget. Get a quote today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can instantly compare rates and coverages from multiple companies
side-by-side to find the right policy for you.

[Learn more about homeowners][39]

#### Give your family the safety net they deserve

Term life insurance can provide you and your family with long-lasting financial security. You
determine how much coverage you need, how long you need it, who you’d like covered, and when you
pay—giving you control of your policy. Quote now to get started.

[Learn more about term life][40]

#### Build a mobile home policy that works for you

With a range of coverages and deductible options to choose from, you can easily create an insurance
policy that protects your mobile home and works with your budget. Start building your policy today.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer specialized protection to cover porches, garages, gazebos, and more.

[Learn more about mobile home][41]

#### Ride with the #1 bike insurer starting at $75/year^{§}

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about motorcycle][42]

#### Pet insurance

With Progressive Pet Insurance by Pets Best, you can create a plan that fits your dog or cat's
needs, as well as your budget. Simply choose a plan and then customize your deductible,
reimbursement percentage, and annual limit.

[Learn more about pet insurance][43]

#### Protect yourself from damage, theft, and more

With renters insurance, your belongings are protected whether they're in your apartment, backseat,
or storage locker. Plus, if you can't stay in your residence due to a covered incident, we'll help
pay for your temporary living expenses. Get covered today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can get a renters policy for less than $1 per day.^{‡‡}

[Learn more about renters][44]

#### Join a leading RV insurer starting at $125/year^{††}

Whether you're a full-time RVer or an occasional road-tripper, you'll find all the coverages you
need at an affordable price right here. Get a quote now and enjoy the open road without worry.

**Why Progressive?:** From windshield & glass coverage to emergency expenses, we have your road trip
covered.

[Learn more about RV][45]

Umbrella insurance provides an extra layer of liability coverage beyond what your home and auto
policy offer, with limits available up to $5 million.

repairs.

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and

Frequently Asked Questions

### Equipment Supplier in Ahmedabad

What types of electrical equipment do you supply?+

Royal Projects Suppliers stocks a wide range of [electrical equipment][76] — MCC panels, control
panels, LV/PVC power cables, cable accessories, LED flood lights and AC drives (VFDs) — from brands
like Schneider, Havells, Siemens and L&T.

What safety equipment and PPE do you offer?+

We supply complete industrial [safety equipment][77] and PPE — safety helmets, shoes, gloves, fire
extinguishers and head-to-toe protective gear from trusted brands such as 3M and Udyogi.

Which power tools are available?+

Our [power tools][78] range includes drill machines (Bosch, Makita), 2-speed industrial drills,
grinders and accessories suited for professional and heavy industrial use.

What hardware equipment do you stock?+

We deal in industrial [hardware equipment][79] — adjustable spanners, hand tools, pipe fittings,
cable glands and fastening tools from brands like Taparia and Jhalani.

What welding equipment and accessories do you supply?+

We supply [welding machines][80] — stud-type and ARC welding machines — along with welding
accessories and consumables from leading brands such as Ador.

Do you supply lifting and scaffolding equipment?+

Yes — we offer industrial [lifting equipment][81] and [scaffolding solutions][82] for construction
and industrial projects across Gujarat.

Are these products available for wholesale or bulk supply in Ahmedabad?+

Yes. As a wholesaler and authorised dealer based in Sanand, Ahmedabad, we supply all product
categories in bulk across Gujarat and pan-India. Call or WhatsApp [+91 99786 15837][83] for a quote.

FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions

### Equipment Supplier in Ahmedabad

What types of electrical equipment do you supply?+

Royal Projects Suppliers stocks a wide range of [electrical equipment][76] — MCC panels, control
panels, LV/PVC power cables, cable accessories, LED flood lights and AC drives (VFDs) — from brands
like Schneider, Havells, Siemens and L&T.

What safety equipment and PPE do you offer?+

We supply complete industrial [safety equipment][77] and PPE — safety helmets, shoes, gloves, fire
extinguishers and head-to-toe protective gear from trusted brands such as 3M and Udyogi.

Which power tools are available?+

Our [power tools][78] range includes drill machines (Bosch, Makita), 2-speed industrial drills,
grinders and accessories suited for professional and heavy industrial use.

What hardware equipment do you stock?+

We deal in industrial [hardware equipment][79] — adjustable spanners, hand tools, pipe fittings,
cable glands and fastening tools from brands like Taparia and Jhalani.

What welding equipment and accessories do you supply?+

We supply [welding machines][80] — stud-type and ARC welding machines — along with welding
accessories and consumables from leading brands such as Ador.

Do you supply lifting and scaffolding equipment?+

Yes — we offer industrial [lifting equipment][81] and [scaffolding solutions][82] for construction
and industrial projects across Gujarat.

Are these products available for wholesale or bulk supply in Ahmedabad?+

Yes. As a wholesaler and authorised dealer based in Sanand, Ahmedabad, we supply all product
categories in bulk across Gujarat and pan-India. Call or WhatsApp [+91 99786 15837][83] for a quote.

with numbers so that each row, column and 3×3 section contain all of the digits between 1 and 9. As

The popular Japanese puzzle game Sudoku is based on the logical placement of numbers. An online game
of logic, Sudoku doesn’t require any calculation nor special math skills; all that is needed are
brains and concentration.

## How to play Sudoku

The goal of Sudoku is to fill in a 9×9 grid with digits so that each column, row, and 3×3 section
contain the numbers between 1 to 9. At the beginning of the game, the 9×9 grid will have some of the
squares filled in. Your job is to use logic to fill in the missing digits and complete the grid.
Don’t forget, a move is incorrect if:
* Any row contains more than one of the same number from 1 to 9
* Any column contains more than one of the same number from 1 to 9
* Any 3×3 grid contains more than one of the same number from 1 to 9

can be a bit intimidating for beginners. So, if you are a complete beginner, here are a few Sudoku
tips that you can use to improve your Sudoku skills.

## PEOPLE: Designers & Stewards

*Pioneers of American Landscape Design* chronicles the lives and careers of those who have designed
our gardens, parks, streets, campuses, cemeteries, suburbs, and the innumerable other environments
in which we live.

### Edward L. Daugherty Oral History


His six decade career ranges from small gardens and estates to colleges, cultural institutions,
religious properties, and environmentally sensitive large developments. In this interview, Daugherty
reflects on his life, the city of Atlanta, his career, and such notable projects as Georgia's
Governor's mansion.

## STEWARDSHIP: Landslide

The goal of *Landslide* is to draw immediate and lasting attention to threatened landscapes and
unique features, and to encourage informed, community-based stewardship decisions.

[Get Involved][133]

#### [First Amendment vs. Metal Fence ][134]

Lafayette Park, across the street from the White House, is ground zero for free speech—now the
administration plans to enclose this landmark with permanent ten-foot-tall metal fencing.

## PEOPLE: Designers & Stewards

*Pioneers of American Landscape Design* chronicles the lives and careers of those who have designed
our gardens, parks, streets, campuses, cemeteries, suburbs, and the innumerable other environments
in which we live.

### Edward L. Daugherty Oral History


His six decade career ranges from small gardens and estates to colleges, cultural institutions,
religious properties, and environmentally sensitive large developments. In this interview, Daugherty
reflects on his life, the city of Atlanta, his career, and such notable projects as Georgia's
Governor's mansion.

## Treppenlicht-Zeitschalter ELPA 540 APP BN: Kompakte dezentrale Lösung für den Unterputz bei
## Platzmangel

Wenig Platz in der Unterputzdose, hoher Zeitdruck auf der Baustelle und aufwendige Umbauten? Der
**ELPA 540 APP BN** bietet Elektroinstallateuren eine **kompakte und intelligente Lösung für die
Treppenlichtsteuerung.** Der Treppenlicht-Zeitschalter im Miniformat wird direkt in der
Unterputzdose installiert, benötigt keine zentrale Steuerung und lässt sich komfortabel per App
konfigurieren.

beide geprägt von klarer Formensprache, feiner Haptik und **hochwertiger Materialauswahl.**

# Great Place to Work statt nur ein Arbeitsplatz

[Kununu Siegel Theben AG 2022 2026]Theben ist ein echter „Great Place to Work“. Nicht nur, weil wir
im Rahmen des Zertifizierungsprogramms **Great Place ****to**** Work® Certified** zum zweiten Mal
ausgezeichnet wurden.  Oder weil wir als **zweitbester Arbeitgeber in Baden-Württemberg** prämiert
wurden. Oder weil wir zu den bestbewerteten Arbeitgebern der Branche bei **[kununu][180] **zählen.
Kurz gesagt: Arbeiten bei Theben lohnt sich, erlebe es selbst! 

[Mehr zur Karriere bei Theben][181] [Direkt zu den Stellenangeboten][182]

### Energie am richtigen Ort zur richtigen Zeit

Kein Bereich unseres täglichen Lebens kommt mehr ohne die Frage nach dem Energieeinsatz aus. Doch
vielen guten Ideen stehen oftmals die Bequemlichkeit des Menschen und seine Angst vor Komfortverlust
im Weg. Dabei braucht es keine Gebäude, die vom Keller bis zum Dach gleichmäßig temperiert oder
ausgeleuchtet sind. Komfort benötigt der Mensch lediglich in seinem direkten Umfeld, er wandert
bestenfalls wie ein schützender Kokon aus Wärme, Licht und Luft mit ihm von Raum zu Raum. Genau
diese Komfortzone rund um den Menschen hat das Konzept der [**Human Centered Building
Automation**][183] im Blick.

[**Mehr zu energiesparenden Lösungen von Theben >>**][184]

# Willkommen bei Theben: Den Experten für KNX, Zeitschaltuhren, Präsenz- und Bewegungsmelder

Hinter jeder unserer Lösungen steht der Gedanke, Energie nur dann einzusetzen, wenn sie wirklich
gebraucht wird: sei es bei der automatischen Lichtsteuerung
mit [Präsenzmeldern][185], [Bewegungsmelder][186][n][187] oder [LED-Strahlern][188], bei der
Lichtsteuerung mit
[DALI-Komponenten][189], [Dimmern][190] und [Treppenlicht-Zeitschaltern][191] oder bei
der [Klimasteuerung][192] mit [KNX-Aktoren][193], [CO2-Sensoren][194] und [Raumthermostaten][195].

TheKronometre.com, zamanı saat, dakika, saniye ve milisaniye cinsinden ölçen ücretsiz bir online
kronometredir. Bu kronometre 6 temel işlev sunar: başlatma, durdurma, tur kaydı, sıfırlama, tam
ekran modu ve CSV veri dışa aktarma. Spor, eğitim, yemek pişirme, verimlilik ve bilimsel araştırma
alanlarındaki profesyoneller, hassas zamanlama için TheKronometre'yi doğrudan tarayıcıda kullanır —
Android, iOS, Windows ve macOS üzerinde — kurulum gerektirmez.

## Kronometre Nasıl Çalışır?

**Kronometre (chronometer), geçen süreyi yüksek doğrulukla ölçen bir hassas zamanlama aracıdır.**
Uluslararası Ağırlıklar ve Ölçüler Bürosu (BIPM), kronometreleri 4 ana alanda kullanılan hassas
zamanlama cihazları olarak sınıflandırır: atletizm, bilimsel araştırma, endüstriyel üretim ve
eğitim.

Standart bir kronometre 3 temel bileşenden oluşur: bir başlat/durdur mekanizması (düğme), bir zaman
göstergesi ve bir sıfırlama işlevi. Modern dijital kronometre cihazları, bölüm süresi (split time)
takibiyle tur kaydı, milisaniye ölçümü ve CSV veri dışa aktarma özelliklerini de içerir.

Kronometre çeşitleri (mekanik, dijital, online), tarihçesi, salise kavramı ve kronometre ile
zamanlayıcı arasındaki fark gibi konuların ayrıntılı açıklaması için [Kronometre Nedir?][7]
rehberimizi inceleyebilirsiniz.

[ Bir kronometrenin üç fonksiyonunu, üç türünü ve gerçekte nasıl çalıştığını keşfedin ][8]

## Online Kronometre Nedir?

**Online kronometre, herhangi bir bilgisayar, tablet veya akıllı telefonda uygulama indirmeden
çalışan tarayıcı tabanlı bir dijital kronometredir.** Online kronometre araçları, tarayıcı
penceresinde doğrudan milisaniye hassasiyeti sunmak için cihazın yüksek çözünürlüklü performans
zamanlayıcısını kullanır.

TheKronometre.com, telefon tabanlı kronometre uygulamalarına göre 6 avantaj sunar: sıfır kurulum,
depolama alanı kullanmama, otomatik güncellemeler, Android, iOS, Windows ve macOS genelinde çapraz
platform uyumluluğu, klavye kısayolu desteği ve tam masaüstü ekran kullanımı. Online kronometre
Chrome, Safari, Firefox ve Edge'de çalışır.

## Kronometre Geçmişi

1821

### Nicolas Mathieu Rieussec

Fransız saatçi Nicolas Mathieu Rieussec ilk bağımsız kronografı icat etti. Rieussec'in cihazı, at
yarışları sırasında geçen süreyi işaretlemek için kadran yüzeyinde mürekkep damlaları kullandı; bu
mekanizmayı ilk gerçek geçen zaman ölçüm cihazı haline getirdi.

1862

### Adolphe Nicole'ün Kalp Parçası

Adolphe Nicole kalp parçalı kamın patentini alarak saat yapımında devrim yarattı. Bu mühendislik
atılımı, kronograf ibrelerinin anında sıfırlanmasına olanak tanıdı ve modern kronometre sıfırlama
fonksiyonunun temelini attı.

1932

### Olimpik Hassas Zamanlama

İsviçreli üretici Omega, Olimpiyat Oyunları zamanlaması için 1/5 saniye hassasiyetine sahip
kronograf mekanizmalarını tanıttı. Bu, profesyonel spor kronometresinin küresel ölçekte
standardizasyonunun başlangıcı oldu.

1970s

### Dijital Kuvars Çağı

Kuvars bazlı elektronik kronometreler, mekanik yayları tamamen ortadan kaldırarak benzeri görülmemiş
1/100 saniyelik (10 milisaniye) doğruluk elde etti. Uluslararası Ağırlık ve Ölçü Bürosu (BIPM),
dijital hassas zamanlama için resmi uluslararası standartlar oluşturdu.

1990s

### Yaygın Tüketici Benimseme

LCD üretimindeki ilerlemeler, dijital kronometrelerin ekonomik ve kompakt olmasını sağlayarak eğitim
amaçlı fiziksel programlarda, mutfak ortamlarında ve tüketiciye yönelik spor etkinliklerinde
evrensel olarak benimsenmesine yol açtı.

2010+

### Tarayıcı Tabanlı Yerel Araçlar

Hassas zamanlamaya fiziksel cihazlar olmadan erişilebilmesini sağlayan çevrimiçi kronometre araçları
ortaya çıktı. TheKronometre.com, milisaniyenin altındaki dahili doğruluk için son derece duyarlı 10
ms'lik görsel ekranla birlikte gelişmiş modern tarayıcı API'lerini kullanır.

## Online Kronometre Nasıl Kullanılır?

Bu kronometre aracını kullanmak için eksiksiz bir zamanlama oturumu için şu 5 adımı izleyin.

### Temel Kullanım: Adım Adım

1
▶

#### Başlat

Zamanlama başlatmak için **BAŞLAT** butonuna tıklayın veya klavyenizde Boşluk (Space) tuşuna basın.

2
🏁

#### Tur Kaydet

**TUR** butonuna veya L tuşuna basın. Her tur, bireysel tur süresini ve kümülatif bölüm süresini
görüntüler.

3
⏸

#### Duraklat

Duraklatmak için tekrar Boşluk tuşuna basın (**Duraklat**). Devam etmek için bir kez daha Boşluk
tuşuna basın (**Devam et**).

4
↺

#### Sıfırla

Kronometreyi sıfıra döndürmek için R tuşuna basın veya **SIFIRLA** butonuna tıklayın.

5
📄

#### Veri Dışa Aktar

Tüm tur kayıtlarını dışa aktarmak için **CSV İndir** butonuna tıklayın. Dosyayı Excel, Google Sheets
veya LibreOffice Calc'ta açın.

Odaklanma Çalışması 🔬 Bilim ve Araştırma

### 🏃 Spor ve Atletizm

Koşu, yüzme, bisiklet ve kürek sporlarında **bölüm süresi (split time)** takibi, performans
analizinin temelidir. World Athletics teknik kurallarına göre resmi müsabaka zamanlaması için 1/100
saniye (10 milisaniye) hassasiyet zorunludur.

Sporcular ve antrenörler, her aralık için tur sürelerini kaydetmek, antrenman seanslarını
karşılaştırmak ve uzun vadeli performans takibi için CSV verisi dışa aktarmak amacıyla online
kronometreyi kullanır. Türkiye Atletizm Federasyonu (TAF), lisanslı yarışma antrenmanları için
dijital ölçüm araçlarını teşvik etmektedir.

### 📚 Eğitim ve Sınav Hazırlığı

Zaman yönetimi sınav başarısını belirler. Türkiye'nin YKS sınav sisteminde TYT, öğrencilerin 135
dakikada (8.100 saniye) 120 soruyu tamamlamasını gerektirir — soru başına ortalama 67,5 saniye.

Deneme sınavlarında her bölüm başında **TUR** tuşuna basarak bölüm sürelerini kaydedin. Her çalışma
oturumundan sonra bölüm bazlı analiz için CSV dosyasını dışa aktarın. Pomodoro tekniği — 25 dakika

olup, çalışmayı 25 dakikalık odaklanma seansları ve 5 dakikalık molalar şeklinde yapılandırır. Bu
yöntem erteleme alışkanlığını azaltır ve tutarlı çıktıyı korur.

Kronometreyi başlatın, 25 dakika çalışın, ardından mola dönemi için sıfırlayın. Serbest çalışanlar
ve uzaktan çalışanlar, tamamlanan Pomodoro döngülerini kaydetmek ve iş günü boyunca toplam verimli
saatleri takip etmek için tur kaydıyla kronometreyi kullanır.

### 🔬 Bilim ve Araştırma

Laboratuvar deneyleri, reaksiyon süresi ölçümleri ve gözlem protokolleri, milisaniye çözünürlüğünde
hassas zaman ölçümü gerektirir. Sarkaç salınım ölçümleri, kimyasal reaksiyon zamanlaması ve insan
tepki süresi çalışmaları, dışa aktarılabilir verilerle tarayıcı tabanlı hassas zamanlamadan
yararlanır.

Kronometrenin **CSV Dışa Aktarma** özelliği, araştırmacıların ve üniversite öğrencilerinin zamanlama
verilerini doğrudan analiz programlarına aktarmasını sağlar. Dışa aktarılan her dosya tur numarası,
toplam süre ve bölünmüş süre (split time) bilgilerini içerir.

## Öne Çıkan Özellikler

TheKronometre.com, 6 profesyonel düzeyde özellik sunar. Tümü ücretsizdir, kayıt veya ödeme
gerektirmez.

⏱

### Milisaniye Hassasiyeti

Cihazınızın yüksek çözünürlüklü performans zamanlayıcısını kullanarak 10ms görüntü çözünürlüğü.
Doğruluk, telefon tabanlı kronometre uygulamalarının çoğunu aşar.

🏁

### Tur Kaydı ve İstatistik

Otomatik en hızlı tur ve en yavaş tur vurgulama ile sınırsız tur. Her kaydedilen aralık, bireysel
tur süresini ve kümülatif bölüm süresini gösterir.

🖥️

### Tam Ekran Modu

Sunumlar, koçluk seansları ve odaklanmış zamanlama için dikkat dağıtmayan tam ekran kronometre.
Girmek için F, çıkmak için ESC tuşuna basın.

📄

### CSV Dışa Aktarma

Tüm tur verilerini tek tıkla dışa aktarın. Dışa aktarılan dosyaları filtreleme, grafik oluşturma ve
performans analizi için Excel, Google Sheets veya LibreOffice Calc'ta açın.

⌨️

### Klavye Kısayolları

Space, L, R ve F tuşları fare etkileşimi olmadan tam kontrol sağlar. Antrenman ve sınav pratiği
sırasında hız için tasarlandı.

Tüm özellikler Android, iOS, Windows ve macOS tarayıcılarında çalışır. Kurulum, abonelik veya ödeme
gerektirmez.

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular

TheKronometre hakkında bilmeniz gereken her şey.

Bu online kronometre nasıl kullanılır?
**Zamanlama başlatmak için Başlat butonuna tıklayın veya Space tuşuna basın.** Tur kaydetmek için L
tuşuna basın. Duraklatmak için tekrar Space tuşuna basın. Sıfırlamak için R tuşuna basın. Tur
verilerinizi kaydetmek için CSV İndir'e tıklayın. Kronometre doğrudan tarayıcınızda çalışır —
kurulum veya hesap gerektirmez.
Neden bu kronometre ve sayaç sistemini seçmelisiniz?
**TheKronometre.com, 6 özelliği tek bir araçta birleştirir:** milisaniye hassasiyeti, en hızlı/en

sıfır reklam ile sıfır veri takibine sahip dikkat dağıtmayan bir arayüz.
Hangi cihazlarda çalışır?

cihazlar (iPhone ve iPad), Windows bilgisayarlar ve macOS sistemleri. Chrome, Safari, Firefox ve
Edge desteklenir. Dokunmatik ekrana optimize kontroller mobil ekranlarda çalışır.
